name: continuity-mcp
description: Durable project state across AI sessions for Cursor (and any MCP host): decisions, constraints, and rejected paths, versioned in git as plain markdown. Adapted from vikcena01/ai-continuity-plugin.
author: Ashish Sharma

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli.ts src/mcp.ts src/hook-session-start.ts src/hook-stop-capture.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.test: npm run build && bash test/smoke.sh && bash test/reconcile.sh && bash test/risks.sh && bash test/resolve.sh && bash test/schema.sh && bash test/budget.sh && bash test/review.sh && bash test/churn.sh && bash test/mission.sh && bash test/search.sh && bash test/guard.sh
